description: Patent-disjoint OOD split from USPTO OpenMolecules data. HiTEA is a single publication and cannot provide a patent split; USPTO is patent-derived so split_key (patent document hash) is used as the group key.  Train/val/test patents are disjoint.
limitation: USPTO split_key is a hash; the exact patent number is not directly available, but split_key uniquely identifies patent documents in the OpenMolecules extraction.
index_reference: Row positions in uspto_openmolecules_normalized.csv (NOT HiTEA parquet)
